# ts-launch-blueprint

> A production-ready TypeScript CLI, API, and web workspace template with best
> practices baked in: a gh-style noun-verb CLI (`ts-projects`) on Commander, a
> typed core library (`@ts-launch-blueprint/core` with Zod schemas), a Hono +
> tRPC API (`@ts-launch-blueprint/api`), a React + Vite web app
> (`@ts-launch-blueprint/web`), and a fork-ready rename system (`template-press`)
> so the whole stack can be rebranded in one command.

Architecture in one line: `packages/core` holds pure schemas, repositories, and
services; `apps/cli` (`ts-projects`) is a thin CLI over it; `apps/api` serves
REST + tRPC over `createCore`; and `apps/web` is a React + Vite front-end
importing only the `AppRouter` type from `@ts-launch-blueprint/api/router`.

- [Documentation hub](https://github.com/smorinlabs/ts-launch-blueprint/blob/main/docs/docs.md): index of guides, tutorials, reference docs, and tool docs
- [Agent guidelines](https://github.com/smorinlabs/ts-launch-blueprint/blob/main/AGENTS.md): canonical commands and rules for AI coding agents (imported by [CLAUDE.md](https://github.com/smorinlabs/ts-launch-blueprint/blob/main/CLAUDE.md))
- [Changelog](https://github.com/smorinlabs/ts-launch-blueprint/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md): release history (release-please managed)

## Architecture & Contracts

- [Architecture overview](https://github.com/smorinlabs/ts-launch-blueprint/blob/main/docs/about/architecture.md): workspace layers, request flow, and add-a-feature checklist
- [Boundary rules](https://github.com/smorinlabs/ts-launch-blueprint/blob/main/docs/reference/boundary-rules.md): enforceable import rules and removable-app guarantees
- [CLI reference](https://github.com/smorinlabs/ts-launch-blueprint/blob/main/docs/reference/cli-reference.md): `ts-projects` flags, output formats (`text`/`json`/`markdown`), and config paths
- [API reference](https://github.com/smorinlabs/ts-launch-blueprint/blob/main/docs/reference/api-reference.md): Hono + tRPC endpoints, observability, and smoke checks
- [Web app reference](https://github.com/smorinlabs/ts-launch-blueprint/blob/main/docs/reference/web-app.md): React + Vite + TanStack Query + tRPC client setup
